title: Lantern Cafe: Wi-Fi portal server logged into with a guessed password
types: Unauthorised access of IT systems or data
must: Indicators should include the attacker's address, 203.0.113.66.
Say which system was affected: the Wi-Fi portal server, portal01.
Say what you have done so far (password reset, SSH blocked).
Say whose data the portal holds: guests' phone numbers.

inbox.subject: Logs requested
inbox.body: Please preserve the portal server's auth.log for 14 November 2026 and tell us which time source the server uses.

inbox.subject: The till PC too?
inbox.body: A barista says a new account called support2 appeared on the till PC this morning. Is that part of the same thing? Does it change what we tell CERT-In?
